GAMA-Bench includes eight classic game-theory scenarios:
1) Guess 2/3 of the Average
2) El Farol Bar
3) Divide the Dollar
4) Public Goods Game
5) Diner’s Dilemma
6) Sealed-Bid Auction
7) Battle Royale
8) Pirate Game

The authors group them into three categories:
- Cooperative Games: Guess 2/3 of the Average, El Farol Bar, Divide the Dollar
- Betraying Games: Public Goods Game, Diner’s Dilemma, Sealed-Bid Auction
- Sequential Games: Battle Royale, Pirate Game
